description.sr: 22. juna 1941. godine počinje operacija Barbarosa, nemački napad na Sovjetski Savez u tri glavna pravca, od kojih je jedan usmeren prema Moskvi (centralna grupa armija); ovaj datum podiže Drugi svetski rat na potpuno novi nivo.
description.en: On June 22, 1941, Operation Barbarossa began, the German attack on the Soviet Union along three main axes, one of which was aimed at Moscow (Army Group Center); this date raised World War II to an entirely new level.

events.quote: oni počinju 22. juna 1941. godine ... imamo dakle ta tri glavna pravca, jedan je prema Moskvi

title.sr: Staljinov predlog Čerčilu za otvaranje drugog fronta
title.en: Stalin's proposal to Churchill to open a second front

description.sr: Jula 1941. godine, svega mesec dana nakon početka operacije Barbarosa, Staljin predlaže Čerčilu da se otvori novi front u Francuskoj (Normandiji); Čerčil odgovara da je ideja dobra, ali da nije još vreme za to.
description.en: In July 1941, just a month after the start of Operation Barbarossa, Stalin proposed to Churchill that a new front be opened in France (Normandy); Churchill replied that the idea was good, but the time was not yet right.

events.quote: Churchillu predlaže da se otvori novi front i to baš u Francuskoj, dakle u Normandiji ... u julu 1941. godine
